§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

C1 English Excellence Expert

Brice Gadou is an English language specialist dedicated to building rigorous, engaging training for advanced learners. Canopy reflects the stage after roots, sprout, bloom, and harvest — the mature, full-grown height from which a fluent mind can finally see the whole landscape at once.

Designed for C1 learners ready to discuss consciousness, geopolitics, and the future of humanity with genuine precision — Canopy is more than a word list. It's the vocabulary of real intellectual command.
